When the sun is wrapped up and loses its light.
When the stars fall and scatter.
When the mountains are moved away.
When the best camels, the ones people value most, are left alone.
When the wild animals are gathered together.
When the seas are set on fire.
When souls are joined with others like them.
When the baby girl who was buried alive is asked.
For what crime she was killed.
When the pages of everyone's deeds are opened.
When the sky is peeled away.
When Hell is made to blaze.
When Paradise is brought close.
Then each soul will know what it brought with it.
Allah swears by the stars that move back and hide.
The ones that run along their paths and then set.
And by the night as it falls.
And by the morning as it breathes.
That this Quran is the word of a noble messenger, Jibril.
He has great strength and a high rank with the Lord of the Throne.
He is obeyed there in the heavens, and he is trusted.
Your companion Muhammad is not crazy.
He saw Jibril on the clear horizon.
And he does not keep back the message from the unseen.
And this Quran is not the word of a cursed devil.
So where are you going?
It is only a reminder for all the worlds.
For whoever among you wants to go straight.
But you cannot want anything unless Allah, Lord of the worlds, wants it.
